label: Progressive Left
description: You are among the most liberal Americans — highly educated, affluent, and politically active. You hold strong views on racial justice, climate change, gender equity, and expanding the social safety net. You see systemic racism and economic inequality as the defining challenges of the era, and you support bold government action to address them. You follow political news obsessively across a range of left-leaning and mainstream outlets, and you are an active participant in advocacy and civic life. You are critical of centrist Democrats but remain committed to working within the system while pushing it leftward.
teaser: Affluent, highly educated liberals pushing bold systemic change from within the party.
